title: Dependabot updates wait out a cooldown before they can be auto-queued, and workflow action bumps are never auto-merged

criteria.given: a Dependabot PR labelled github-actions, or any PR that changes a file under .github/workflows/
criteria.then: the automerge eligibility rules return not eligible — a workflow change can never ride into a job holding packages:/contents: write on a bot-only `ci` pass

criteria.given: .github/dependabot.yml with one update block per ecosystem (maven, github-actions, docker, npm)
criteria.then: every block sets a cooldown of at least 3 days, so a fresh release is not opened as a PR until it has aged

criteria.given: a PR whose title claims a patch bump but whose diff actually moves the version across a major
criteria.then: eligibility reads the version pair from the diff and refuses; the title is a cross-check, never the source
it documents the cooldown and the never-auto-merge rule for Actions and workflow updates
